brainlife.desc: Cortical surface meshes as GIFTI in left/ and right/ folders (pial, white, inflated, etc.).
brainlife.name: neuro/surface/vertices

original.desc: Surface vertices (3D mesh) stored in <left/right>/<name>.gii. Where <name> is the name of the surface such as pial, white, inflated, etc.
original.readme:
```
left/
    pial.gii
    white.gii
    inflated.gii
    (etc..)
right/
    pial.gii
    white.gii
    inflated.gii
    (etc..)
```
